Game animation sprite sheet: EXACTLY 8 frames in a 4 columns x 2 rows equally spaced grid on real transparent alpha. Reference is identity/outfit only, redraw Yama chibi red demon boy in gold Thai crown, black crimson robe with gold trim, barefoot. No book. Animation animator's coherent key poses for ONE powerful diagonal sword CUT, not thrusting, not drawing sword in/out. All frames fixed three-quarter profile facing right, same face, sword length, hand grip, planted feet, body proportions, camera and scale. Each frame has ample blank margin (body max 60% cell height, sword fully inside), no crop or adjacent overlap. Read left to right then row two.
Frame 1: READY both hands hold gold sword hilt near right chest, blade points diagonally UP RIGHT.
Frame 2: WINDUP hands pull hilt up beside forehead, sword blade extends diagonally UP LEFT behind head; torso turns back slightly.
Frame 3: TOP windup hands ABOVE forehead, blade points nearly VERTICAL UP; elbows bent.
Frame 4: DOWNWARD SWING blade points diagonally UP RIGHT, hands move forward and downward; bright thin curved blade motion streak near upper right tip.
Frame 5: CONTACT blade extended HORIZONTALLY RIGHT at chest height, hands ahead of body, torso rotates forward, knees bent; clear crescent slash trail arcing from above head clockwise toward right.
Frame 6: FOLLOW THROUGH sword extended DIAGONALLY DOWN RIGHT, hands lower forward, torso leans forward; crescent trail ends at low right. Blade passes through one continuous clockwise arc from frame3 to frame6, NEVER reverses within strike.
Frame 7: HOLD END keep same low forward blade angle and same grip as frame6, smaller lean, no upward sword movement.
Frame 8: RECOVER hands return toward chest, blade diagonally up right matching frame1 so loop closes. Recovery is visibly separate from strike.
Hands NEVER slide along blade or hilt; two hands together on the SAME hilt throughout. Full body distinct sprites. Faithful crisp detailed pixel-art chibi aesthetic matching reference. No floor, no shadows, no words or labels, no borders, no other figures. Wide sheet 2:1, genuine transparent background.
asia: Create EXACTLY 8 animation frames on transparent alpha in 4 columns x 2 rows. First reference is Yama character identity and maroon gold patterned kimono, tall black scholar hat, white socks and sandals, straight steel jian outfit: match this clothing, hat, chibi red demon boy face. Second reference is animation pose sequence ONLY. Reproduce the SECOND reference's eight poses and single coherent clockwise diagonal sword-cut choreography, changing costume to FIRST reference. Do NOT put Thai crown or Thai costume on this character. Both hands grip the SAME sword hilt, same blade length across all eight frames. No book. All face right three-quarter profile, fixed proportions, camera, planted feet and body anchor. Frame1 ready sword up-right held at chest; 2 windup sword up-left behind head; 3 top sword vertically overhead; 4 swing sword diagonally up-right with faint curved motion streak; 5 contact sword horizontally right with thin white curved slash trail; 6 follow-through sword diagonally down-right lean forward; 7 hold low blade same downward angle as 6; 8 recover sword up-right held at chest exactly matches frame1. Crucial: one continuous sweep from overhead through right to low-right, never blade thrusting in and out. Include visible arc in strike frames4-6 to sell swinging, no giant magic explosions. Detailed crisp pixel-art matching first reference. Technical grid: each full-body figure including blade and arc MUST fit INSIDE its cell with 10% transparent padding on all four sides, body height max55% of cell. ALL frames and motion streaks separated by large clear blank gutters, no overlapping between rows or columns, no touching edges, no cropped blades. No words, no borders, no background, no floor shadows. Wide 2:1 transparent sheet.
